items.title_zh: 快速入门 | OpenBCI 文档
bullets_zh: OpenBCI 官方文档，介绍 Cyton、Ganglion 及相关 EEG 硬件的快速入门。
涵盖板卡设置、生物传感配置、头带/电极、软件与社区资源。
适合作为消费级非侵入式 BCI 实验的初学者入口。
bullets_en: Official OpenBCI documentation for getting started with Cyton, Ganglion, and related EEG hardware.
Covers board setup, biosensing configurations, headwear/electrodes, software, and community resources.
Useful as a beginner entry point for consumer non-invasive BCI experiments.

items.title_zh: 欢迎来到 BrainFlow 文档！— BrainFlow 文档
items.title_en: Welcome to BrainFlow’s documentation! — BrainFlow documentation
bullets_zh: BrainFlow 官方文档，介绍可读取多种板卡 EEG/EOG/ECG 数据的跨平台库。
列出支持设备，如 OpenBCI Cyton/Ganglion、Galea、NeuroMD、BrainBit、Callibri 及合成/流式板卡。
为使用标准化信号处理 API 构建非侵入式 BCI 应用提供参考。
bullets_en: Official BrainFlow documentation for a cross-platform library that reads EEG/EOG/ECG data from many boards.
Lists supported devices such as OpenBCI Cyton/Ganglion, Galea, NeuroMD, BrainBit, Callibri, and synthetic/streaming boards.
Useful reference for building non-invasive BCI applications with standardized signal processing APIs.

包含支持板卡（如 OpenBCI Cyton/Ganglion）及其他消费级设备的示例代码。
帮助开发者用实用代码片段实现非侵入式 BCI 流程。
bullets_en: BrainFlow examples show how to stream, record, filter, and analyze EEG/EOG/ECG data.
Includes sample code for supported boards such as OpenBCI Cyton/Ganglion and other consumer devices.
Helps developers implement non-invasive BCI pipelines with practical snippets.
